title: Canopy plugin manifest (canopy.json)
description: Schema for a Canopy plugin manifest. Mirrors PluginManifest + Contributions in @canopy/core. A plugin DECLARES what it is, what it may access (capabilities), and what it contributes to the host UI; the host grants only what is declared.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case plugin id (e.g. "image-viewer"). Used everywhere the plugin is referenced.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what the plugin does.

icon.description: lucide icon name shown on sidebar / rail / store surfaces (e.g. "image", "file-text", "sparkles").

color.description: HSL accent string WITHOUT the hsl() wrapper, e.g. "38 92% 50%". Used for tinted icon backgrounds.

entry.description: Entry module path within the source folder/zip, relative to the manifest. Defaults to "index.js".

capabilities.description: What the host will grant. Nothing is ambient — declare only what you need. A viewer needs just { "kind": "item:read" }.

serverHooks.description: Server-side hooks the plugin implements. Runs inside the (planned) server sandbox.

oneOf.description: Read the bytes/metadata of the item being acted on (every viewer needs this).
Write back to the item being acted on (editor viewers; saves only to the current file).

connectors.description: Restrict to specific storage mounts, e.g. ["documentation"]. Omit = all readable mounts.

oneOf.description: Read files from a storage mount through the host API.

hosts.description: Allow-list of hostnames the plugin may fetch from, e.g. ["api.github.com"].

oneOf.description: Outbound fetch, restricted to the named hosts only.
A small per-plugin, per-user key/value store (backed by the shared cache).

models.description: Restrict to specific model ids (from the host's AI models). Omit = any model the caller can reach.

oneOf.description: Run text/vision inference through the host's AI gateway — the plugin never holds a provider key; the host routes to whichever provider owns the model.

contributions.description: Declarative UI surface. The plugin describes what it adds; the host renders the slots.

kinds.description: Restrict to item kinds (e.g. ["pdf","image"]); omit = all items.

railPanel.description: A panel the plugin renders into the right-hand rail.

section.description: Sidebar section heading the launcher is grouped under (e.g. "Apps", "Tools").

nav.description: Add a launcher for this view to the left sidebar. Omit to keep it reachable only from Home / the plugin list.

immersive.description: Render edge-to-edge: the host drops its page header and centred max-width column so a canvas-style app owns the whole area.

detailView.description: A full-page view opened from the sidebar.

detailFields.description: Extra rows in the file preview details grid.

viewers.description: Sandboxed file-type viewers. The host loads the entry module into an opaque-origin iframe and hands it only the previewed file's bytes.

title.description: Label shown on the preview surface (e.g. "PDF").

match.description: MIME types and/or extensions handled. Each entry is an exact MIME ("application/pdf"), a MIME wildcard ("image/*"), a dot-extension (".heic"), or a bare extension ("pdf").

fill.description: Fill the preview box instead of auto-growing to content (media/canvas viewers).

immersive.description: When expanded full screen, take over the surface: the host hides the metadata sidebar, the prev/next nav arrows and the max-width cap, and yields the arrow keys to the viewer.

tagline.description: Short blurb shown on the store card.

store.description: How the plugin appears in the plugin store.

provides.description: Which host surfaces this plugin feeds typed records into.

config.description: Config the source needs to connect (rendered as a settings form).

dataSource.description: Declares typed data providers (tasks / calendar). The provider factory is registered host-side, keyed by plugin id.
